Lesson5 uses mathematical practice/feedback and compact reference rather than decorative images. All-diagram flags received editorial review against fixed illustrated reference: images support observation and explanation, with captions, margin placement, labelled roles, readable typography and contextual imagery retained. No reduced-standard exception requested or used.

Convex_Lens.jpg candidate was a diagram, inspected then rejected/deleted. No uninspected video linked.
